chunks: And from a sermon of his (peace be upon him) that is specific to mentioning the battles (or great events).

key_terms.الْمَلَاحِمِ: The battles or great events (plural of Lahm, referring to fierce conflicts or eschatological signs)

ai.seo_question: What does the term 'al-Malahim' refer to in Imam Ali's sermons?
ai.summary: This heading introduces a distinct sermon within Nahj al-Balagha where Imam Ali (AS) elaborates on 'al-Malahim' (the great battles or eschatological upheavals), a central motif in his discourse on the vicissitudes of time. In Shia scholarly tradition, these events are often interpreted not merely as historical conflicts but as signs of the transition from the era of the Rightly Guided Caliphs to the rise of the Ahl al-Bayt, reflecting the divine decree of historical change.
